title: Matchstick Squares
summary: Count shared sides once; each new item adds only the new parts.

steps.title: The puzzle
sentences: Squares are made in a row from matchsticks, with neighbouring squares sharing a side.
How many matchsticks make 3 squares in a row?
points: Squares are made in a row from matchsticks, with neighbouring squares sharing a side.

steps.title: How to think about it
sentences: Count the first square fully and then only the new sides for each next square.

steps.title: The method: Count only new sides
sentences: Each extra square next to it shares one side and needs only 3 new sticks.

steps.title: The answer
sentences: 3 squares in a row need 10 matchsticks.
The pattern is 3 times the number of squares plus 1.
points: 3 squares in a row need 10 matchsticks.

quiz.q: How many matchsticks for 5 squares in a row?
